summary.en: The largest lymphoid organ, lying in the left upper abdomen.
summary.zh: 最大的淋巴器官，位于左上腹。

detail.en: Lies against the diaphragm under ribs 9 to 11 on the left and is normally not palpable. The red pulp filters blood and removes old red cells; the white pulp mounts immune responses. Supplied by the splenic artery, a branch of the celiac trunk.
detail.zh: 位于左季肋区，贴膈、对第9~11肋，正常情况下肋下不能触及。红髓滤血并清除衰老红细胞，白髓参与免疫应答。血供来自腹腔干的分支脾动脉。

function.en: Filters blood, recycles iron, stores platelets and generates immune responses against blood-borne antigens.
function.zh: 滤血，回收铁，储存血小板，并对血源性抗原产生免疫应答。

clinical.en: The spleen is the most commonly injured abdominal organ in blunt trauma; after splenectomy patients are vulnerable to encapsulated bacteria.
clinical.zh: 脾是腹部钝性伤中最易受损的脏器；脾切除后易感染有荚膜细菌。

summary.en: Primary lymphoid organ in the anterior mediastinum where T cells mature.
summary.zh: 位于前纵隔的中枢淋巴器官，T细胞在此成熟。

detail.en: Two lobes lie behind the manubrium and in front of the great vessels. It is largest in childhood and involutes after puberty, being gradually replaced by fat.
detail.zh: 分左、右两叶，位于胸骨柄后方、大血管前方。儿童期最发达，青春期后逐渐萎缩并被脂肪组织替代。

function.en: Provides the environment for T-lymphocyte maturation and selection.
function.zh: 为T淋巴细胞的发育成熟与选择提供微环境。

clinical.en: Thymoma is associated with myasthenia gravis.
clinical.zh: 胸腺瘤常伴发重症肌无力。
